cases.issue:
This report is through a private channel (email). 
Report: A review of the Jenkins codebase identified several outdated cryptographic practices, including the continued presence of SHA1 usage, an insufficient Diffie-Hellman key size (512 bits instead of the recommended 1024+ bits), and AES key derivation from MAC addresses.

Response: We reviewed the reported issues and confirmed that they exist in a deprecated part of the Jenkins codebase that has already been replaced and is no longer in active use. This legacy code belongs to the old Jenkins CLI, which was officially removed as noted in our 2019 blog post “Remoting CLI Removed.” We plan to review and possibly remove the remaining outdated code to ensure the repository continues to meet current security and maintenance standards.
